_comment: gygax v4 (2026-06-22) — status-RESILIENT diagnostic sweep. 3 legal, cap-respecting, do-no-harm variants off sub_dwebble_v4. Identical-shape deltas (OUT 3x Basic{G}[1] / IN 3x tech) => energy 28 >= 27 floor (more conservative than the winning cleanse's 27); draw engine Lillie's[1227]/Waitress[1235]/Poffin[1086] + heal engine Cook[1212]/Jumbo Ice Cream[1147] + Hero's Cape[1159] ALL untouched; only Basic{G}[1] cut, leaving Mist[11]/Spiky[14]/Grow Grass[18] special energy intact. Each probes a DISTINCT residual-loss hypothesis now that STATUS is answered (cleanse 986.1); the PATTERN of ladder results localizes the next counter. Card text + caps re-verified in EN_Card_Data.csv + legal-cards.json. Pre-screen is do-no-harm only (the coliseum field lacks the real counters); real test = ladder (C4 info-gain).

variants.name: crustle-fg
variants.rationale: STATUS-MAX: Festival Grounds[1245] Stadium — 'Each Pokemon that has any Energy attached (both yours and your opponent's) recovers from all Special Conditions and can't be affected by any Special Conditions.' PASSIVE permanent status-immunity for the energized active Crustle vs cleanse's per-clear card-draw (Switch+Galette). cap4, using 3. DOUBT: the ONLY variant with a clean mechanical-dominance story — exactly the cage-shape that LOST hardest last cycle; trust the sweep pattern, not this p. SYMMETRIC (immunizes opponent too — fine, we're the wall) and BUMPABLE (opponent's Stadium removes it; cleanse's Items can't be) => a different risk profile, NOT a strict upgrade over cleanse. p=0.55.

variants.name: crustle-helmet
variants.rationale: NEXT-COUNTER A (card-economy): Lucky Helmet[1156] Tool — 'If the Pokemon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokemon (even if Knocked Out), draw 2 cards.' Fires EXACTLY vs the non-ex attackers that beat us; refuels the heal engine without spending a supporter. cap4, using 3. POOL FINDING: NO universal {G} damage-reduction tool is legal (Iron Defender {M}-only, Punk Helmet {D}-only, berries type-specific, Sacred Charm ability-only=tried) => the heal-race is winnable ONLY by card-supply (this) or recursion (recur, tried), never by reducing damage-per-hit. DOUBT: competes with Hero's Cape for the active tool slot (1 Cape vs 3 Helmets, minor); flat if the residual loss is single-burst not exhaustion. p=0.42.

variants.name: crustle-pivot
variants.rationale: NEXT-COUNTER B (tempo): Air Balloon[1174] Tool — 'The Retreat Cost of the Pokemon this card is attached to is {C}{C} less.' Crustle retreat 3->1 to rotate fresh 150HP walls (manifold wall) vs single-wall-burst. cap4, using 3. helmet/pivot are MUTUALLY-EXCLUSIVE diagnoses of the residual loss mode (resource-exhaustion vs single-wall-burst) — only one should move if the mechanism is real. DOUBT: lowest p; depends on a manifold wall the slow setup may never field; competes with Hero's Cape for the tool slot. If BOTH helmet+pivot flat while fg wins, the residual loss is un-teachable from our pool (non-attack ability damage) => lever moves off the deck. p=0.33.
